first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early adoption. A guarded simplification experiment directly targets both issues while avoiding promotional pricing, whose acquisition gains previously came with materially worse 30-day retention. Monitor qualified activation, retention, and revenue quality to ensure faster completion does not reduce downstream value.

final.rationale: Run a small guarded test shortening onboarding, prioritizing the confirmed broad improvement in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention. Signup simplification supports the direction for SMBs but showed a slight retention decline and did not replicate beyond SMB, so it should not be generalized. Measure onboarding completion, activation, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention by segment before expanding.
